November 18 – December 16, 2026

Return of the Treat Legion

Earn Moon Coins once per day per roster from Chaos Dungeons or by harvesting a Guardian Soul. There is also a chance to receive a Golden Pastry, which contains one random reward.

November 18, 2026 – January 13, 2027

Vestiges of the End

Fight six returning bosses in a four-player dungeon. Normal starts at 1730 and Hard at 1770. One stage opens per week for the first six weeks. Clear each stage to unlock the next. The final two weeks give you time to finish. Open the purple cube icon next to the minimap when you reach 1730.

Entry and combat rules

  • Unlimited entries, retries and repeat clears, including stages already cleared. Stage-clear progress is tracked per character.
  • Event Gold is outside the endgame Gold limit. Azena’s Blessing does not award the additional first-phase rewards in this event.
  • Bosses have no enrage and the fight continues through a full party death. Revives are unlimited and cost no currency. A support effect activates if the party has no support character.
  • Missing the revive countdown removes you from the dungeon. Inactivity triggers a warning, followed by removal if you stay inactive.

Stage 1 · Griffon challenges

  • Interrupt the Griffon’s special attack once.
  • Avoid Pursuing Spear. No party member can take damage from its periodic hits. Leaving the fight fails the challenge.
  • Defeat the Griffon without taking damage from Strike of Ruin. Leaving the fight fails the challenge.

Each boss has three challenges, for 18 total. Track them in the event window or the upper-left corner in combat. Hard challenge completion also counts on Normal. Roster challenge progress carries forward through the event.

Vestiges of the End

Clear and Mission Rewards

First-clear rewards per stage · per character

Each stage pays out once per character per difficulty. A Hard first clear grants the Normal rewards too if you still have them to claim. Items are character-bound. Across all six stages, that’s 60,000 Gold on Normal or 180,000 Gold with both tracks per character.

Systems and quality of life

Other Changes

  • Find Party and Battle Presets. A new event category is being added to both menus.
  • Pantheon Resonance. Auto-upgrade until the next rank is reached or available materials run out.
  • Battle items. Powerful Euphoria and Atropine-X no longer share a cooldown.
  • Mount summoning. Summon animations are removed. Animations purchased with bonus currency are refunded in bonus currency.
